scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" --filter @anyq/e2e typecheck

TURNSTILE_SITEKEY.description: Optional. [Turnstile](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile) site key. The default is a test key that always passes.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional. Turnstile secret key matching the site key. The default is a test key that always passes.
